entities.summary: Jussi Aalto is a Finnish former professional footballer who played as a forward. Aalto represented a number of teams in Finland including Helsingin Jalkapalloklubi, Vaasan Palloseura (VPS) and Seinäjoen Jalkapallokerho (SJK).
